description: Téléphonie mobile - Exposition aux champs électromagnétiques is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction de la Transition Écologique et du Climat - Ville de Paris. Datasets on the annual average of the average level of exposure to electromagnetic fields of mobile telephony measured in private establishments and enclosed living spaces. Coverage: Direction de la Transition Écologique et du Climat - Ville de Paris. The portal shows the English title as "Mobile telephony - Exposure to electromagnetic fields" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direction de la Transition Écologique et du Climat - Ville de Paris. Its keywords include telephonie, ondes, electromagnetique, qualite-environnementale, dtec, environnement. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2025-06-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
